audit.reasoning: (1) Quote confirmed verbatim in the held Pádua 2007 text layer and PDF at the stated section; only the printed-page locator is off by one (29-30, not 28-29). (2) The coding UNDETERMINED rests on the only phonological description of the language (2007 MA dissertation), cross-checked against the only grammar (Sousa 2017 PhD), both held; neither states where stress falls, and Pádua's own transcriptions/underlying forms mark stress lexically on final, penult and (once) initial syllables without comment, so no rule can be read off. (3) No better source exists: Glottolog has one descriptive ref, SAPhon lists no suprasegmentals, CrossRef shows no post-2017 linguistic work, and the language has effectively no fluent speakers left, so an instrumental or prosodic study is not to be expected.
